name: Hashi no Ue no Ouji-sama
source:
Nashiko is an unhappy girl who grew up in a state facility. But she keeps image of a "Prince" who she met on a bridge 10 years ago, and that allows her to live through hardships with a smile. Will she meet a nice rich man?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-july-2006-bra-ban.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
梨子是在福利机构长大的不幸少女。但她始终记得10年前在桥上遇见的那位“王子”，正是这段回忆让她即使身处逆境，也能微笑着生活。她会遇到一位富有而善良的男子吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-july-2006-bra-ban.html]vndbreview[/url]]
